# Obviously Awesome

Position a product through alternatives, unique strengths, best-fit customers and category.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Define product positioning by mapping competitive alternatives, unique attributes, and best-fit customers to the right market category. Use when the user mentions "positioning", "competitive alternatives", "how to position", "market category", "positioning canvas", "repositioning", "category creation", "what category are we in", or "why prospects dont get what we do". Also trigger when launching a new product, entering a crowded market, or diagnosing why prospects dont grasp the product's value. Covers the positioning canvas and team workshops. For customer jobs analysis, see jobs-to-be-done. For go-to-market, see crossing-the-chasm.

Example request:

> Use obviously-awesome to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill obviously-awesome
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/obviously-awesome/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/obviously-awesome/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
